public_body: West Boylston Zoning Board Of Appeals
overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by discussing an unlisted topic on Feb 24, 2014 that the Chair anticipated, but ordered no additional relief and declined the 2013 allegations as untimely.

allegations.summary: Board discussed a letter about a Comprehensive Permit at its Feb 24, 2014 meeting, but the posted notice did not list it, though the Chair anticipated discussing it 48 hours ahead.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, because the topic was not included  on the posted agenda, we find that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law  by discussing it.

allegations.summary: Complaints alleged similar improper topics at Board meetings on May 28, 2013, Oct 8, 2013, and Oct 28, 2013, filed well after the 30-day window.
allegations.key_passage: Because the complaints were not filed  until more than 90 days after those meetings occurred, we find these allegations  untimely and decline to review them.

note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
